statements.subject: client
statements.description: The client fills in the 'ciaddr' field only when correctly configured with an IP address in BOUND, RENEWING or REBINDING state.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The client fills in the 'ciaddr' field only when correctly configured with an IP address in BOUND, RENEWING or REBINDING state.
statements.guard_semantics: protocol.state = BOUND | protocol.state = RENEWING | protocol.state = REBINDING

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the client includes a list of parameters in a DHCPDISCOVER message, it MUST include that list in any subsequent DHCPREQUEST messages.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If a server receives a DHCPREQUEST message with an invalid 'requested IP address', the server SHOULD respond to the client with a DHCPNAK message and may choose to report the problem to the system administrator.
statements.trigger: receive DHCPREQUEST with invalid requested IP address
